checks.text: The page displays the heading "Local Photo Gallery" and the text "No photos yet" in the main content area.
After dropping a file named "sunset.jpg" (simulated via the file input), a grid item appears with the label "sunset.jpg" and a thumbnail. The text "No photos yet" is removed.
Clicking the grid item labeled "sunset.jpg" opens a full-screen lightbox overlay displaying the image and a close button labeled "Close".
In the lightbox, clicking the button labeled "Rotate 90" rotates the displayed image 90 degrees clockwise. The button label remains "Rotate 90".
In the lightbox, clicking the button labeled "Export" triggers a download of a file named "sunset_rotated.jpg". The lightbox remains open.
Closing the lightbox by clicking "Close" returns to the grid view. The grid item "sunset.jpg" is still present.
After adding a second file "beach.png", the user drags the "beach.png" item above the "sunset.jpg" item using the drag handle. The grid order becomes "beach.png" first, then "sunset.jpg".
Clicking the button labeled "Delete beach.png" on the grid item removes that item from the grid. The grid now contains only "sunset.jpg".
Reload keeps the remaining photo "sunset.jpg" in the grid and the heading "Local Photo Gallery".
